page.overview:
Who is Brooks?

Admiral Brooks was a high-ranking Starfleet officer in the 2360s.

Following the incident involving the Borg drone Hugh in 2368, Captain Picard submitted a full report to Admiral Brooks. This report was mentioned one year later in a conversation between Picard and Admiral Alynna Nechayev. ()

When Doctor Crusher was faced with a board of inquiry in 2369, she told Guinan that she could already hear Admiral Brooks telling Beverly how much she had disgraced Starfleet Medical. ()
